verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document settlement or balance reports, per seller or rolled up, delivered as files or APIs on a schedule. The closest items are adjacent rather than reconciliation reporting: an embeddable 'reporting' UI component, a general claim that data can be exported at any time, configurable deposit (payout) frequency, and status-change webhooks. None of these shows that scheduled reconciliation reports are delivered to a finance stack.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule
